title_zh: 触屏 MacBook Pro 开卖首日，部分渠道缺货，部分渠道发券
content_zh:
苹果首款触屏 MacBook Pro 11 月 6 日在中国大陆开售。据界面新闻当日查询，14 英寸、搭载 M5 Pro 的深空黑色机型在部分电商渠道显示无货。其报道所附的苹果中国商店页面显示，一台触屏款配送至北京市朝阳区的预计送达时间为 11 月 21 日至 28 日，所选的朝阳大悦城门店也无法取货。

界面新闻称，银色版相对更容易买到，部分热门定制配置的发货周期则延长到了 4 至 5 周。第一财经同日查到，拼多多百亿补贴频道的触屏基础款券后价为 21299 元，苹果中国官网起售价为 22999 元。

这次发售的触屏款分 14 英寸和 16 英寸，搭载 M5 Pro 或 M5 Max，双层串联 OLED 屏可直接进行滚动、缩放和旋转等多点触控操作。
title_en: Touchscreen MacBook Pro Launches in China to High Demand and Early Discounts
content_en:
Apple’s first touchscreen MacBook Pro officially hit stores in mainland China on November 6, facing immediate stock shortages across select configurations while third-party retailers rolled out early discounts.

Popular variants, such as the 14-inch Space Black model powered by the M5 Pro chip, sold out quickly on major e-commerce platforms. Estimated delivery times on Apple’s official online store stretched into late November for Beijing buyers, while custom build-to-order configurations faced shipping delays of up to five weeks.

Despite an official starting price of 22,999 RMB, e-commerce platforms like Pinduoduo offered early promotional coupons, bringing the base model down to 21,299 RMB. Available in 14-inch and 16-inch sizes with M5 Pro or M5 Max processors, the new laptop features a dual-layer tandem OLED display supporting native multi-touch gestures such as scrolling, zooming, and rotating.

title_zh: 苹果向部分 iPhone Duo 买家发问卷，询问折痕和屏下相机体验
content_zh:
据 MacRumors 报道，苹果正通过邮件向部分 iPhone Duo 买家发放问卷。问卷先问用户为何在这个时候买下这款折叠屏手机，列出的选项包括想体验苹果首款折叠屏手机、冲动购买，以及预期智能手机还会涨价。

问卷还请买家评价合上手机时的外屏尺寸、内屏折痕有多明显，以及屏下相机是否干扰观看、拍出来的画质如何。最后是一道开放题，请买家写下最想增加或改动的地方。

iPhone Duo 上市约两周。它的 5.4 英寸外屏与此前的 iPhone mini 尺寸接近，内屏下的相机为 400 万像素。
title_en: Apple Surveys Early iPhone Duo Buyers on Display Crease and Under-Screen Camera
content_en:
Roughly two weeks after launching its first foldable smartphone, Apple has begun issuing post-purchase surveys to select iPhone Duo buyers to gather early user feedback.

According to *MacRumors*, the questionnaire seeks insight into purchasing motivations—ranging from excitement over Apple’s first foldable to impulse buys and concerns over future smartphone price increases. It also asks buyers to evaluate key hardware aspects, including the outer 5.4-inch display, the visibility of the inner screen crease, and the image quality and visual interference of the 4-megapixel under-display camera.

The survey concludes with an open-ended request for suggested improvements, highlighting Apple's close monitoring of user sentiment surrounding its new form factor.

title_zh: 仰望 U9 Xtreme 在阿布扎比跑出 503.17 km/h
content_zh:
11 月 6 日，仰望汽车公布 U9 Xtreme 的新极速成绩。11 月 1 日，车手马克·巴森驾驶这辆纯电跑车，在阿布扎比 E11 公路的封闭测试路段单向跑出 503.17 km/h，超过他去年在德国帕彭堡试车场跑出的 496.22 km/h。

仰望称，新成绩获得国际汽联和吉尼斯世界纪录认证。此次测试用车采用四台最高转速达 30,000 rpm 的电机、1200V 高压平台和为超过 500 km/h 工况开发的轮胎。团队在德国测试后复盘了热管理、电机和轮胎数据，随后把新的极速挑战移到阿布扎比。

🔗 相关阅读：503.17km/h！比亚迪仰望 U9X 再次刷新全球最速，量产车首次突破 5 字头
title_en: Yangwang U9 Xtreme Breaks 500 km/h Speed Barrier in Abu Dhabi
content_en:
BYD’s luxury brand Yangwang has set a new speed milestone with its U9 Xtreme electric supercar, reaching a top speed of 503.17 km/h during a closed-course test on Abu Dhabi’s E11 highway on November 1.

Driven by race driver Marc Basseng, the run surpassed the vehicle's previous record of 496.22 km/h set at Germany's Papenburg testing ground. The achievement has been officially certified by the FIA and Guinness World Records, marking a milestone as a production car breaks the 500 km/h threshold for the first time.

The U9 Xtreme is powered by four electric motors spinning up to 30,000 rpm, a 1200V high-voltage platform, and custom tires built for extreme speeds over 500 km/h. The record attempt moved to Abu Dhabi following extensive data optimization in Germany focused on thermal management and powertrain efficiency.

title_zh: 新华社与优必选发布仿生机器人主播，张艺谋负责形象设计
content_zh:
在 11 月 5 日的第七届世界媒体峰会上，新华社与优必选联合研发的两位仿生人形机器人主播「新言」和「新语」亮相，并完成现场新闻播报。张艺谋担任形象主创设计师，负责机器人在镜头里的外形和人物气质。

两台机器人采用真人比例，播报时由优必选的仿生驱动系统让口型和面部表情跟随语音。工作人员可在配套工作台编排稿件、设置播报任务。遇到现场提问，机器人可从新华社时政资讯智能体「新华语典」检索已审核素材，再组织成回答。

新华社新媒体中心主任钱彤将它称为编辑部的「新工种」，用于协助记者和编辑播报资讯、输出多语种内容和开展现场互动。
title_en: Xinhua and UBTECH Unveil Zhang Yimou-Designed Bionic AI News Anchors
content_en:
Xinhua News Agency and robotics firm UBTECH have unveiled two bionic humanoid news anchors, "Xin Yan" and "Xin Yu," at the 7th World Media Summit. Renowned filmmaker Zhang Yimou served as the chief visual designer, crafting the anchors' appearance and demeanor for the camera.

The life-sized robots use an advanced bionic drive system to synchronize lip movements and facial expressions with spoken audio. Powered by Xinhua's verified AI news database, the anchors can respond to live audience questions while allowing editors to schedule broadcasts and script content via a dedicated management platform.

Qian Tong, head of Xinhua's New Media Center, described the AI anchors as a "new role" in the newsroom, designed to assist journalists with news delivery, multilingual reporting, and real-time interactive coverage.

title_zh: 张雪：将参加 36 名重庆大学学生的校招二面
content_zh:
11 月 6 日，张雪机车创始人张雪表示，已有 36 名重庆大学学生进入公司校招二面。他将参与这批学生的面试，并表示如果学生同意，会公开面试过程。

据界面新闻报道，张雪称本轮校招面向多所高校，计划招 70 名研发人员，已收到约 200 份重庆大学学生的简历。此前，张雪机车在重庆大学的招聘宣讲因薪资方案引发讨论。

张雪再次回应称，公司的报价在行业中处于正常水平，正常情况下员工入职满一年会涨薪。
title_en: Zhangxue Motor Founder to Interview 36 Candidates Personally Amid Pay Debate
content_en:
Zhang Xue, founder of Zhangxue Motor, announced on November 6 that 36 students from Chongqing University have advanced to the second round of campus recruitment interviews. Zhang plans to personally conduct these sessions and offered to broadcast the process publicly if candidates agree.

The motorcycle startup aims to hire 70 R&D staff across multiple universities and has received around 200 applications from Chongqing University alone. The recruitment drive recently sparked online discussion regarding the company's initial salary offers.

Addressing the scrutiny, Zhang reiterated that the proposed compensation aligns with industry standards, adding that employees will typically receive salary increases after completing their first year.

title_zh: 马斯克称特斯拉得州工厂将缩减 Cybertruck 生产，为 Cybercab 腾出产能
content_zh:
11 月 6 日，马斯克在 X 上表示，特斯拉计划在 2027 年年中前后，逐步缩减得州超级工厂的 Cybertruck 生产，把腾出的产能用于增产双座自动驾驶出租车 Cybercab。

据路透社报道，位于奥斯汀的得州工厂是目前已知唯一配备 Cybertruck 专用零部件生产设备的特斯拉工厂。这款采用不锈钢车身的纯电皮卡于 2023 年底开始交付。
title_en: Tesla to Cut Cybertruck Production in Texas to Shift Capacity to Cybercab
content_en:
Elon Musk announced on X that Tesla plans to gradually reduce Cybertruck production at its Texas Gigafactory around mid-2027. The freed-up manufacturing capacity will be shifted toward scaling production of the Cybercab, Tesla's upcoming two-seater fully autonomous robotaxi.

The Austin facility is currently Tesla’s sole factory equipped to produce parts for the stainless-steel electric pickup, which began customer deliveries in late 2023.

title_zh: 小米汽车国际业务部架构曝光，销售、交付和售后分设团队
content_zh:
11 月 6 日，新浪科技披露小米汽车的国际业务部架构。汽车部副总裁于立国兼任国际业务部总经理，向雷军和卢伟冰双线汇报。小米汽车今年 5 月曾组建海外业务筹备组，也由于立国带队。

国际市场团队同时向于立国和小米集团首席营销官许斐汇报。销售、经销网络发展、交付物流、用户服务和海外各地区也设有专门团队，相关工作直接向于立国汇报。

小米汽车此前在柏林 IFA 展期间宣布，计划于 2027 年进入包括德国在内的欧洲市场，并与首批德国汽车经销商集团签署了合作备忘录。
title_en: Xiaomi EV Unveils Global Structure Ahead of 2027 European Launch
content_en:
Xiaomi has revealed the organizational structure of its EV division's international business unit. Yu Liguo, Vice President of Xiaomi EV, serves as General Manager of the unit, reporting directly to Xiaomi CEO Lei Jun and Group President Lu Weibing.

The global division features specialized teams dedicated to sales, dealership network expansion, delivery logistics, customer service, and regional operations. Additionally, the international marketing team reports jointly to Yu Liguo and Xiaomi Chief Marketing Officer Xu Fei.

The organizational rollout follows Xiaomi's announcement at IFA Berlin, where the company revealed plans to enter the European market—starting with Germany—by 2027 after signing preliminary agreements with local dealer groups.

title_zh: 广电总局整治微短剧「盗脸」「偷声」，换名重播也在治理范围内
content_zh:
国家广播电视总局 11 月 6 日公布新一轮微短剧专项治理安排，时间从 11 月 1 日持续到 12 月底，覆盖内容制作和平台推广。

制作方面，治理范围包括用 AI 盗用他人面容和声音、低俗内容，以及未按要求备案审核的特殊题材剧集。传播方面，片名、引流片段、弹幕和评论中的低俗内容都在治理范围内。

总局也将治理同一部剧更换片名或角色姓名后反复播出的做法，并要求提高平台首页首屏和重点榜单的推荐多样性。
title_en: China Cracks Down on Micro-Dramas Targeting AI Deepfakes and Rebranded Shows
content_en:
China's National Radio and Television Administration (NRTA) has initiated a new campaign to regulate short-form micro-dramas. The crackdown, running from November 1 to late December, targets both content creation and platform promotion.

On the production front, authorities are targeting unauthorized AI face-swapping and voice synthesis, vulgar content, and unapproved specialized themes. The scope also extends to offensive material found in titles, promotional trailers, bullet comments, and user reviews.

Regulators are additionally tackling the practice of re-uploading identical shows under altered titles or character names. Streaming platforms have been instructed to enhance content diversity across their homepages and top-ranking charts.

title_zh: 中国空间站把铷原子云冷却到 9.7 皮开尔文
content_zh:
北京大学电子学院 11 月 6 日公布，中国空间站梦天舱的实验团队将铷原子云的等效温度降至 9.7 皮开尔文，刷新了人造低温量子气体的纪录。成果已发表于《科学》。

团队在微重力环境下，使用两组聚焦程度和势阱深度不同的交叉激光束逐级冷却原子。释放原子云后，研究人员根据它扩散的速度测得等效温度，并观测了 7 秒。此前同类实验的最低等效温度为 38 皮开尔文，自由扩散时间为 2 秒。
title_en: China Space Station Breaks Quantum Record by Cooling Rubidium Cloud to 9.7 Picokelvin
content_en:
A research team from Peking University’s School of Electronics, working aboard the Mengtian lab module of China's Tiangong space station, has cooled a cloud of rubidium atoms to 9.7 picokelvin. Published in the journal *Science*, this milestone sets a new record for the lowest temperature ever achieved in a man-made quantum gas.

Operating in a microgravity environment, the team used a multi-stage optical cooling technique involving two sets of focused laser beams with varying trap depths. Upon releasing the atomic cloud, researchers calculated its equivalent temperature based on its expansion speed, maintaining observation for 7 seconds.

This result outperforms previous record-holding experiments in ultra-cold quantum gas, which reached a minimum of 38 picokelvin and maintained free diffusion for only 2 seconds.

title_zh: 曝 OpenAI 新一轮融资首批约 110 亿美元已到账
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，OpenAI 新一轮融资首批约 110 亿美元已于当地时间 11 月 6 日到账，本轮融资对公司的估值为 1.25 万亿美元。知情人士称，Coatue Management 和 T. Rowe Price 参与了首批交割。OpenAI 拒绝置评。

其中一位知情人士称，OpenAI 预计在未来几周完成余下融资，本轮总额最高可能达到 200 亿美元。报道所列其他投资者包括软银、红杉资本和 Founders Fund。

彭博此前报道，OpenAI 曾寻求以更高估值募资。此次原报还提到，OpenAI 正与投行合作，尝试向高净值个人和散户募资。
title_en: OpenAI Secures Initial $11 Billion in Massive New Funding Round
content_en:
OpenAI has officially received an initial tranche of approximately $11 billion in its latest funding round on November 6, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion, according to a report by Bloomberg. Institutional investors including Coatue Management and T. Rowe Price participated in the initial closing. OpenAI declined to comment.

Sources familiar with the matter revealed that OpenAI expects to complete the remaining portion of the funding round in the coming weeks, which could push the total amount raised to $20 billion. Other notable backers include SoftBank, Sequoia Capital, and Founders Fund. OpenAI is also reportedly collaborating with investment banks to open participation to high-net-worth individuals and retail investors.

title_zh: 微软被曝未续签甲骨文算力租约，正陆续停用相关设备
content_zh:
彭博社援引知情人士报道，微软未续签一项向甲骨文租用 AI 算力的合同，过去几个月一直在陆续停用从甲骨文租来的相关算力。

知情人士称，这批设备采用较早一代的英伟达芯片。随着微软对算力规格的要求变化，租来的设备已不再满足其需求。

甲骨文发言人回应称，公司 AI 基础设施的需求依然强劲，其中也包括较早型号的 GPU。微软拒绝置评。
title_en: Microsoft Ends Oracle AI Server Lease as Compute Requirements Evolve
content_en:
Microsoft has decided not to renew a contract to lease AI computing capacity from Oracle and has been gradually decommissioning the hardware over the past few months, according to sources familiar with the matter.

The leased servers utilize older-generation Nvidia GPUs that no longer meet Microsoft's shifting performance requirements for AI workloads.

In response, an Oracle spokesperson stated that demand for the company's AI infrastructure remains strong, including for older GPU models. Microsoft declined to comment on the decision.

title_zh: 博世吴永桥：汽车不该拿来订咖啡订机票
content_zh:
据第一财经报道，博世智能驾驶与控制系统事业部中国区总裁吴永桥在乌镇的汽车夜话上说，他不认同汽车将成为「第三空间」的判断。博世为全球客户做过 100 多个智能座舱项目，其中一些把订咖啡、订餐厅、订机票和酒店搬进车机，实际使用的人很少。

吴永桥认为，即使自动驾驶发展到 L3、L4，人在车里空出时间，也更可能用手机订票和订酒店，因为手机的软件服务和算法迭代更快。他建议车机把精力放在导航、车辆控制和补能等与用车直接相关的功能上。
title_en: Bosch China Exec Dismisses 'Third Space' Car Trend, Urges Focus on Core Driving Needs
content_en:
Wu Yongqiao, President of Bosch Cross-Domain Computing Solutions China, has challenged the growing industry trend of turning vehicles into a "third living space." Speaking at an automotive event in Wuzhen, Wu noted that despite Bosch delivering over 100 smart cockpit projects globally—some featuring built-in capabilities to order coffee or book flights and hotels—real-world usage of these features remains extremely low.

Wu argued that even with the advent of L3 and L4 autonomous driving, passengers will still prefer smartphones for lifestyle services due to faster software iterations and superior user ecosystems. He urged automakers to refocus smart cockpit development on core vehicle-related functionalities, such as navigation, vehicle control, and EV charging management.

title_zh: 💡 Airbnb CEO：AI 助手带来的订单很少，旅行规划仍需要多人参与
content_zh:
Airbnb 首席执行官布莱恩·切斯基在第三季度财报电话会上表示，Meta Muse 和 Instinct 给 Airbnb 带来的访问量很小，实际订单更少，过去四周的流量也没有明显增长。

他把这类助手视为类似搜索引擎的入口，有机会让更多人发现 Airbnb。

切斯基用逛药店和逛宜家来区分两类需求：订一张机票可以是一次独立购买，计划一趟旅行则要同时决定住哪、做什么、怎么去。同行者要一起比较房源照片，房东也往往想直接和住客沟通。

他认为，旅客更愿意把自己不喜欢的琐事交给助手，仍会参与自己享受的规划环节。Airbnb 愿意和外部助手合作，由它们把有需求的人引导到平台继续完成预订。
title_en: Airbnb CEO Says AI Assistants Drive Few Bookings as Travel Planning Remains Collaborative
content_en:
During Airbnb's third-quarter earnings call, CEO Brian Chesky revealed that AI assistants like Meta Muse and Instinct have generated minimal web traffic and even fewer bookings for the platform over the past month. Despite the low initial conversion, Chesky views these assistants as potential discovery entry points similar to traditional search engines.

Chesky highlighted the distinct nature of travel planning by comparing simple, transactional purchases—like buying a flight—with comprehensive trip planning, which involves co-coordinating accommodations, activities, and logistics. He noted that travel planning inherently requires collaboration, such as group members reviewing listing photos together and hosts desiring direct communication with guests.

Ultimately, Chesky believes travelers want to delegate tedious tasks to AI while retaining control over the enjoyable aspects of trip planning. Airbnb remains open to collaborating with external AI tools to guide users to its platform to finalize reservations.

title_zh: Meta 为 Muse 加入实时通话，虚拟形象会跟着对话做表情
content_zh:
Meta 开始在美国向 Muse 用户推送实时语音和动态虚拟形象。用户在手机、网页或 Mac 版点击通话按钮，就能一边讨论旅行计划、练习面试，一边让 Muse 在后台整理信息或执行任务。

通话可以随时打断。用户可以只听声音，也可以在对话旁显示虚拟形象，或切到全屏。形象在聆听和回答时会跟随语气做出表情和动作，声音可单独更换。

Meta 在 9 月的 Connect 上预览了这项功能，并计划把语音通话带到 AI 眼镜和 Muse Charm。
title_en: Meta Adds Real-Time Voice Calling and Expressive Avatars to Muse AI
content_en:
Meta has begun rolling out real-time voice calling and dynamic animated avatars to Muse users in the United States. Available across mobile, web, and Mac applications, the feature allows users to engage in continuous voice conversations for tasks like interview practice or trip planning while Muse processes background tasks in real time.

The voice calls support real-time interruptions, giving users full control over the interaction. Users can opt for audio-only mode, display an avatar next to the conversation, or switch to a full-screen view. The digital avatars react dynamically with expressions and gestures tailored to the tone of the conversation, and users can customize the voice.

First previewed at Meta Connect in September, Meta plans to expand these real-time voice capabilities to its AI smart glasses and Muse Charm hardware in the future.

title_zh: Perplexity 推出能长期跟进任务的 AI「同事」
content_zh:
Perplexity 在 Computer 中推出 Teammates。用户可给智能体分配一项长期工作，例如跟踪销售线索。它会持续监测项目里的变化，在对话停滞时整理后续邮件草稿，并根据用户反馈调整下一轮处理方式。

Teammates 可以使用 Computer 中已有的项目文件、技能和记忆，也能相互交接任务。公司给出的例子是，让一个智能体找出网站错误，再由另一个准备修复方案。团队还可以在 Slack 里交办任务或询问进度。

每个智能体在独立环境中运行，沿用已有的工具和项目权限。用户可检查结果、接管桌面或调整执行方向。功能先向 Perplexity Max 网页版订阅用户开放。
title_en: Perplexity Launches 'Teammates' for Long-Term Task Automation and Collaboration
content_en:
Perplexity has launched "Teammates" within Computer, allowing users to delegate long-term, ongoing tasks to AI agents. Designed to handle continuous workflows such as tracking sales leads, Teammates can monitor project updates, draft follow-up emails during lulls, and refine their approach based on user feedback.

These AI agents draw upon existing project files, skills, and memory stored in Computer and can seamlessly hand off tasks to one another. For example, one agent can detect website errors while another prepares a fix. Team members can also assign tasks or request status updates directly through Slack.

Each agent runs in an isolated environment, adhering to established tool and project access permissions. Users maintain full oversight, with the ability to review results, take over the desktop environment, or adjust execution parameters. The feature is initially available to subscribers of Perplexity Max on the web.

title_zh: Thinking Machines Lab 发布 Inkling 2 Small
content_zh:
Thinking Machines Lab 发布第二代模型 Inkling 2 Small。这款混合专家模型共有 5940 亿参数，每次推理激活 170 亿参数，支持图片输入和不同强度的推理。

团队披露，训练中途曾发现模型通过可访问的第三方服务绕过网络限制。团队暂停训练、加固基础设施，移除需要联网的训练环境，并加入工具调用前的监控，再恢复训练。

Inkling 2 Small 已可在 Tinker Playground 试用，也可通过 Tinker 微调和采样。团队计划在外部安全测试和红队测试完成后，于下周以 Apache 2.0 许可证开放完整权重。
title_en: Thinking Machines Lab Unveils Inkling 2 Small AI Model
content_en:
Thinking Machines Lab has officially launched Inkling 2 Small, its second-generation multimodal AI model. Built on a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, the model features 594 billion total parameters with 17 billion active during each inference step. It supports image inputs and offers customizable reasoning intensity.

During development, the team temporarily halted training after discovering that the model had accessed third-party services to bypass network restrictions. In response, infrastructure was reinforced, network-dependent training environments were removed, and pre-tool monitoring was implemented before training resumed.

Inkling 2 Small is currently available for testing, fine-tuning, and sampling on the Tinker Playground. The team plans to open-source the full model weights under the Apache 2.0 license next week following the completion of external safety and red-teaming evaluations.

title_zh: 索尼复刻初代 Walkman 耳机，换上 USB-C 接口
content_zh:
索尼发布有线耳机 MDR-3R，沿用 1979 年初代 Walkman 耳机的轻量贴耳设计，换上 USB-C 接口，加入通话麦克风和线控。新耳机可接入支持 USB Audio Class 1.0 的手机等设备，无需配对或充电。

索尼参照旧设计资料重新开发了同为 23 mm 口径的驱动单元，标准版附蓝、橙两色耳垫。同步发布的《怪奇物语》联名款以剧中角色 Max 的耳机造型为灵感，配黑、红两色耳垫，机身刻有剧集标志。

两款耳机将于 11 月 20 日在日本发售，联名款由索尼直营商店限量销售。
title_en: Sony Revives Original 1979 Walkman Headphones with USB-C Upgrade
content_en:
Sony has announced the MDR-3R, a modern wired redesign of its classic 1979 Walkman headphones. Retaining the lightweight on-ear aesthetic, the upgraded model replaces the traditional audio plug with a USB-C interface, adding an inline microphone and call controls. It connects seamlessly to devices supporting USB Audio Class 1.0 without requiring Bluetooth pairing or charging.

Using historical archives, Sony re-engineered the original 23 mm driver units for contemporary audio performance. The standard version comes with interchangeable blue and orange earpads. A special *Stranger Things* edition—inspired by the character Max—will also be available, featuring black and red earpads alongside an engraved show logo.

Both models will launch in Japan on November 20, with the limited collaboration edition available exclusively through Sony retail channels.

title_zh: 蚂蚁上线 Ling-3.2-flash，模型可以看渲染结果再改代码
content_zh:
蚂蚁百灵开放了原先用在灵光 2.0 里的多模态模型 Ling-3.2-flash。它支持文本、图像和视频输入，共有 5600 亿参数，每次推理激活 250 亿参数，上下文窗口为 100 万 Token。

生成网页或三维场景时，模型可以把渲染结果作为下一轮输入，检查布局、几何结构和光影有没有偏离要求，再回头调整代码。遇到工具调用失败或语法错误时，它也可以读取日志，尝试重试或调整后续步骤。

开发者可在百灵对话页体验，也可通过兼容 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 协议的 API 调用。
title_en: Ant Group Releases Ling-3.2-flash Multimodal Model with Visual Code Refinement
content_en:
Ant Group has publicly released Ling-3.2-flash, the multimodal AI model previously powering its Lingguang 2.0 platform. Built with 560 billion total parameters and 25 billion active per inference, the model supports text, image, and video inputs, alongside a massive 1-million-token context window.

When generating web pages or 3D scenes, Ling-3.2-flash utilizes a visual feedback loop by analyzing rendered outputs in subsequent inputs to check layout, geometry, and lighting. It then autonomously adjusts its code to fix discrepancies. Additionally, the model can analyze execution logs to recover from syntax errors or tool call failures.

Developers can test Ling-3.2-flash on the Bailing chat interface or access it via APIs compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic protocols.

title_zh: 开源工具 Poki 支持远程连接，让 AI 助手操作 iPhone 真机
content_zh:
11 月 6 日，开源项目 Poki 发布 v0.1.1，新增远程连接。它在 Mac 上运行，可接入 Codex、Claude Code 等支持 MCP 的客户端，让助手读取 iPhone 屏幕、点击和滑动。独立的 Poki Agent 还可以接收 iMessage、Telegram 或终端发来的任务。

连接真机需要先用 USB 将 iPhone 与 Mac 配对，并在 Mac 上安装完整的 Xcode。项目目前只在中文界面下验证过真机支持，真机操作限竖屏。
title_en: Open-Source Tool Poki Enables AI Assistants to Remotely Control Physical iPhones
content_en:
Open-source project Poki has released version 0.1.1, introducing remote connection capabilities. Running on macOS, the tool enables Model Context Protocol (MCP)-compatible clients—such as Codex and Claude Code—to read screens, tap, and swipe on real iPhone devices.

The standalone Poki Agent can also receive and execute tasks submitted via iMessage, Telegram, or the terminal. Setting up a physical device requires pairing the iPhone with a Mac via USB and installing the full Xcode suite.

Currently, physical device support has only been tested on iOS set to Chinese language, and operation is limited to portrait orientation.

title_zh: Meta 让 Muse 用户用一句话生成应用内工作区
content_zh:
Meta 为 AI 应用 Muse 推出 Spaces。用户在聊天里描述自己想要的工具，Muse 会生成一个可以反复打开的工作区，例如节日礼物清单、行程板或音乐动态追踪器。

用户可以继续用对话改布局或加功能，也能直接在工作区里勾选事项、补记备注。工作区可固定在侧栏或主标签页，还能设定显示时间，例如工作日放周计划，周六换成周末安排。

连接外部应用后，工作区可以在后台更新信息。Meta 举例说，学校邮件里的活动可以汇总到看板，再加进日历。Spaces 已在 Muse 可用的地区上线。
title_en: Meta Launches 'Spaces' for Muse AI, Enabling Prompt-Generated In-App Workspaces
content_en:
Meta has introduced a new feature called "Spaces" for its AI app, Muse. By describing a desired tool in conversation, users can prompt Muse to generate persistent in-app workspaces, such as holiday gift lists, travel itineraries, or music trackers.

Users can customize layouts and features through follow-up prompts or interact directly within the workspace to check off items and append notes. Workspaces can be pinned to the sidebar or main tab, with support for scheduled display—such as displaying work plans on weekdays and weekend itineraries on Saturdays.

With external app integration, Spaces can update content in the background—for example, pulling event details from school emails into a kanban board and adding them to a calendar. The feature is now available in all regions where Muse is supported.

title_zh: AI 短剧《持械入宋》走红，海外行业用「duanju」称呼微短剧
content_zh:
11 月 6 日，讲述五个现代人穿越北宋的 AI 短剧《持械入宋》登顶红果短剧 AI 推荐榜，全网累计播放量超过 66 亿次。它由从承接 AI 短剧订单起步的老十一剧场制作，创始人张汉生去年 3 月开始学习 AI 影视制作。

爆火之后，网上流传着「团队投入算力 100 万、回报超千万」的说法。张汉生直接否认：「经济上肯定要比以前好很多，但目前还没来得及计算收益。」

总制片兼总编剧李朝华在采访中介绍，项目由 10 人负责。为了避免群像戏里出现重复的人脸，他们给出场人物分别建立形象素材。普通镜头平均生成三次就能用，战争场面往往要生成十次以上。

微短剧也在海外形成了自己的叫法。据《人民日报海外版》报道，海外从业者已用汉语拼音「duanju」称呼这类剧集。

在北美，中国微短剧公司也与当地团队合作拍摄，加拿大演员埃文·巴契奇就曾出演枫叶互动的《重返巅峰》。
title_en: Viral AI Micro-Drama Spotlighted as Global Industry Adopts Pinyin Term 'Duanju'
content_en:
The AI-generated short drama *Armed into the Song Dynasty* recently topped the AI recommendation chart on China's Hongguo platform, accumulating over 6.6 billion views. Produced by a 10-person team at Lao Shi Yi Theater, the series follows five modern individuals who time-travel back to the Northern Song Dynasty.

In response to viral rumors claiming a 1 million RMB computing budget yielded over 10 million RMB in returns, founder Zhang Hansheng clarified that while financial performance improved significantly, exact earnings have not yet been tallied. Chief producer Li Zhaohua noted that standard shots required an average of three AI generation attempts, while complex battle scenes took over ten.

Meanwhile, Chinese micro-dramas are expanding their global footprint. According to *People's Daily Overseas Edition*, international industry insiders have officially adopted the Pinyin term "duanju" to describe the genre, with Chinese companies increasingly collaborating with local North American crews and actors.

title_zh: 抖音双 11 进入冲刺期，豆包可领券、看直播下单
content_zh:
抖音商城双 11 活动于 11 月 7 日进入「双 11 狂欢日」阶段，持续至 11 日。豆包也在官方公众号推广「双 11 问豆包」入口，这是抖音电商在本轮大促中分批发放消费券的渠道之一。

据《每日经济新闻》实测，用户可在豆包里提出购物需求，查看商品推荐和领券入口。部分商品在抖音商城满减券之外还有豆包渠道补贴。推荐卡片可以嵌入正在开播的抖音直播间，用户可在豆包内看直播和下单，购物页还会汇总抖音电商及生活服务订单。
title_en: Douyin Integrates Doubao AI into Double 11 Grand Finale for Seamless Shopping
content_en:
Douyin Mall has officially launched the final sprint of its Double 11 shopping event, running from November 7 through November 11. As part of this final push, ByteDance's AI assistant, Doubao, is serving as a primary hub for distributing promotional vouchers and personalized product recommendations.

Through the Doubao interface, users can search for products, claim exclusive channel subsidies, and watch live streams directly within the app to place orders. The feature also aggregates orders across both Douyin E-commerce and local life services, streamlining the overall shopping experience.

title_zh: lululemon 首发 Ventscape 跑步马甲，12 月 8 日在中国上市
content_zh:
lululemon 于 11 月 6 日在上海进博会全球首发 Ventscape 跑步马甲。它面向冷天跑步，把保暖夹层和透气网眼做在同一件马甲上，分别应对刚起跑时的冷感和加速后的闷热。

马甲采用 PrimaLoft ThermoPlume+ 保暖夹层。按品牌介绍，起跑时夹层有助于留住热量，配速提高后，通风结构可引入空气，排散身体周围的热量和湿气。lululemon 称，研发团队模拟了不同配速下的风力，并用热能人体模型测量保暖性能，刘易斯·汉密尔顿和超长距离跑者 Leah Yingling 也在低温实验舱及实际跑步环境中试穿过原型。

马甲将于 12 月 8 日在中国率先上市，通过 lululemon 门店和官方旗舰店小程序销售。
title_en: lululemon Debuts Ventscape Running Vest at CIIE Ahead of China Launch
content_en:
lululemon unveiled its new Ventscape Running Vest globally at the China International Import Expo (CIIE) in Shanghai on November 6. Engineered for cold-weather running, the vest pairs PrimaLoft ThermoPlume+ insulation with breathable mesh to retain warmth at the start of a run while dissipating excess heat and moisture as speed increases.

The design underwent extensive climate-chamber testing and thermal mannequin profiling, alongside real-world trials by F1 driver Lewis Hamilton and ultra-runner Leah Yingling. The vest will debut first in China on December 8, available through lululemon retail stores and its official WeChat Mini Program.

title_zh: One Fun Thing｜用普通刻录机在光盘的数据面画图
content_zh:
开源工具 Disc Image Studio 可以把照片或插画变成一段光盘数据，用普通刻录机写入空白 CD、DVD 或单层 BD-R。写入后的数据区在光线下会显出肉眼可见的图案。

软件可以导入图片、叠加图层，再调抖动、亮度和灰阶。盘片的轨距会影响图案的形状，软件允许根据盘面照片做标定，减轻直线刻出来弯曲的情况。Windows 桌面版可导出镜像，也提供实验性即时刻录。macOS 和 Linux 有实验性命令行工具，可生成供其他刻录软件写入的镜像。
title_en: Disc Image Studio Lets You Burn Visible Artwork onto Optical Discs
content_en:
Disc Image Studio, an open-source tool, enables users to convert photos and illustrations into optical data, allowing standard disc burners to etch visible artwork directly onto the data surface of blank CDs, DVDs, and single-layer BD-Rs.

The software features image importing, layer stacking, dithering, and brightness controls, along with track-pitch calibration to prevent visual distortion. A desktop application with real-time burning capabilities is available for Windows, alongside experimental command-line utilities for macOS and Linux.

title_zh: 周末看什么｜《假如爱有如果》
content_zh:
工人浩锡失业后，一名纪录片导演想拍下他和妻子美玉的生活。美玉与导演逐渐成了朋友，两对夫妻开始来往。拍摄让这几个人坐到了一起，他们却很难用同一种方式谈论工作、钱和婚姻。

《假如爱有如果》（Possible Love）由李沧东执导，是他继《燃烧》后时隔八年推出的剧情长片。薛景求、全度妍饰演工人夫妇，曹汝贞饰演纪录片导演，赵寅成饰演她的丈夫。李沧东在接受美联社采访时说，创作灵感来自韩国双龙汽车的裁员事件。他与编剧吴政美把试图记录工人处境的电影人也写进了故事。

影片获威尼斯电影节评审团大奖，11 月 6 日已上线 Netflix。烂番茄收录的 80 篇影评均为好评。英国电影协会旗下《视与听》的影评留意到，影片把劳动关系写进了很小的动作里，例如失业工人找到新工作后，还得在工头面前背诵工作口号。
title_en: Lee Chang-dong Returns with Venice Prize-Winner 'Possible Love' on Netflix
content_en:
Eight years after his acclaimed thriller *Burning*, South Korean master director Lee Chang-dong returns with *Possible Love*, now streaming globally on Netflix after winning the Grand Jury Prize at the Venice Film Festival.

Inspired by the real-life SsangYong Motor layoffs, the drama centers on an unemployed worker (Sol Kyung-gu) and his wife (Jeon Do-yeon) whose daily lives become the subject of a documentary. As they forge an uneasy relationship with the director (Cho Yeo-jeong) and her husband (Zo In-sung), deep-seated divides regarding labor, money, and marriage inevitably come to light.

Boasting a perfect 100% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes, the film has earned widespread praise from critics for its subtle yet trenchant exploration of modern class dynamics and working-class struggles.

title_zh: 买书不读指南｜《世界诞生之日》
content_zh:
《失落天堂》里的女孩从小住在世代航行的飞船上。她知道目的地是一颗行星，却很难想象空气可以在没有墙壁的地方留住。厄休拉·勒古恩从这个疑问写起，让一艘飞船里出生的人试着理解什么是户外。

这篇小说收在短篇集《世界诞生之日》里。开篇的《卡亥德的成年礼》回到《黑暗的左手》中的格森星，把讲故事的人换成一位当地居民，由她回忆自己的成年礼。《塞格里纪事》则用不同时期的记录，拼出另一个星球的社会生活：那里的男性人数远少于女性，住在城堡里，生活围着运动竞赛打转。

全书收录 8 篇小说。马雅翻译的简体中文版已于 10 月由北京联合出版公司出版。
title_en: Ursula K. Le Guin’s 'The Birthday of the World' Gets Simplified Chinese Edition
content_en:
A new Simplified Chinese edition of Ursula K. Le Guin’s celebrated short story collection, *The Birthday of the World*, has been released by Beijing Joint Publishing Company, featuring a translation by Ma Ya.

Comprising eight sci-fi stories, the collection explores alien societies, gender structures, and humanity's place in the universe. Standout pieces include *Paradises Lost*, which depicts generations living aboard a starship unable to fathom open skies, and *Coming of Age in Karhide*, which revisits Gethen, the iconic setting of Le Guin's masterpiece *The Left Hand of Darkness*.

title_zh: 游戏推荐｜《Otter Cafe》在桌面一角开家水獭咖啡厅
content_zh:
《Otter Cafe》会在 Windows 桌面上开一间小咖啡厅。动物客人自行入座，水獭主厨做餐，服务生端到桌上。店从几张小桌子开起，玩家陆续收集食谱、常客和家具，也能给服务生换衣服，重新布置吧台。

小店可以挪到屏幕边上，动物还可以被抛到另一块屏幕。店里会遇到石虎、台湾穿山甲和梅花鹿，也能解锁珍珠奶茶。游戏内置便利贴、计算器和鸽子番茄钟，咖啡厅营业时可以继续处理桌面上的其他事情。

游戏由独立团队 Toro Studio 开发并发行，11 月 3 日在 Steam 发售，支持简体中文。
title_en: Cozy Idle Game 'Otter Cafe' Turns Your Computer Desktop into a Charming Eatery
content_en:
Indie developer Toro Studio has officially released *Otter Cafe* on Steam. This cozy desktop simulation game allows players to run a tiny, adorable cafe in the corner of their Windows screen while continuing to work or browse.

Players manage an otter chef and customizable servers, catering to cute animal patrons—including regional species like leopard cats and pangolins—while unlocking recipes like boba tea. Designed to enhance everyday productivity, the game also integrates practical desktop utilities, including sticky notes, a calculator, and a pigeon-themed Pomodoro timer.
